name: Handles & Shot Footwork
summary: Loosen up your handle, sharpen your footwork into jumpers, lock in your defensive stance, then finish with hard conditioning bursts.

drills.name: Shamgod Walk-Throughs
drills.summary: Learn the push-and-pull of the Shamgod slowly, then add speed.
steps: Walk forward and push the ball out wide with your right hand.
Pull it back across your body with your left hand.
Step through with your right foot as the ball comes back.
Do 10 slow reps, then 10 at jog speed.
Switch hands and repeat.

drills.name: Hop vs. 1-2 Step Jumpers
drills.summary: Shoot off both footwork patterns and feel which one balances you best.
steps: Start at the right elbow with the ball. Toss it out and catch it on a hop.
Land on both feet at once, square up and shoot.
Next rep, catch it and land inside foot first, then outside foot (1-2).
Alternate hop and 1-2 for 10 shots per elbow.
Finish with 5 shots each way from both wings.

drills.name: Active Hands Stance Ladder
drills.summary: Build stance strength and active hands that bother the ball.
steps: Get in a low stance with your feet wider than your shoulders.
Hold for 20 seconds while you flick your hands at an imaginary ball.
Slide 3 steps right, then 3 steps left, without your feet touching.
Hold the stance again for 20 seconds.
Repeat the hold-and-slide ladder until the timer ends.

drills.name: Baseline-to-Elbow Burst Reps
drills.summary: Short sprints with a shot at the end to train scoring while tired.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble to the right elbow, then pull up and shoot.
Grab your rebound and sprint back to the baseline.
Repeat to the left elbow.
Go nonstop for 45 seconds, rest 15, and repeat 4 rounds.
